description.value: Bold Knight Restaurant is a classic full-service steak and seafood house in Nanaimo, established in 1977 and voted Nanaimo's Best Steakhouse in 2025. The menu leans heavily into charbroiled cuts, fresh BC seafood, and surf-and-turf combinations, with a broad cocktail and wine list. It sits along the Trans-Canada Highway, making it a recognizable landmark for cyclists passing through the south Nanaimo corridor.

The full dinner menu, beverage list, and kids menu confirm it is a sit-down steak and seafood restaurant matching the OSM cuisine tags.
